description: Who reported holding this issuer on Form 13F for one period (newest by default). Top 25 by default; page the full list. About 35% of 13F rows lack dual-evidence CIK links and are left out. Costs 3 credits. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.
